data: Below are the Sample ID's in the Batch. It is not necessary to fill the below, unless it is useful for you while prepping the samples to put an x or put cursor and scan ID in next to each sample to verify you are done with the batch.
Transfer 3.0 mL of the top layer to a 5 mL tube container with 0.75 mL of water.
Pipette 2.5 mL of the solution into 3 mL Captiva EMR Lipid cartridge on the positive pressure manifold with 15 mL Falcon collection tube.
Allow the liquid to drip by gravity until empty or use the pressure manifold to deliver a drop every 3-5 seconds on the low-pressure setting.
Allow the liquid to drip by gravity until empty or use the pressure manifold to deliver a drop every 3-5 seconds on the low-pressure setting.
Once there is no more standing liquid left in the EMR tube, increase the pressure to ~6 – 15 PSI on the low-pressure setting for about 30 seconds to elute all the remaining liquid from the tube.
Cap the 15 mL Falcon tube, briefly vortex, and vial (DF=2).
